text:
sasha_support: hitting a weird streaming freeze in python SDK when tokens rotate. generator yields nothing after partial multibyte char.

katie_engineer: which sdk version? auth rotation path?

sasha_support: python-sdk 0.9.2, using SSE via client.stream, reproducible when a token refresh happens mid-stream. logs show '204 No Content' from auth refresh endpoint and then generator blocks.

lee_sre: can you paste the minimal repro and headers? also any bytes logs of the SSE chunk boundaries?

sasha_support: repro attached below. it's a simple loop that yields server-sent events. sometimes the SSE chunk splits a utf-8 3-byte char across two TCP packets -> our parser waits for event delimiter and hangs.

jonathan_repro: saw similar with emoji sequences. patch idea: buffer until valid utf8 or process bytes not str. quick fix: decode errors='replace' then reassemble events.

sasha_support: here's the snippet that reproduces with harvester of packets:
```
from redwood import Client
import os

c = Client(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'])
for event in c.stream('chat.completions', model='rw-large', input='send emoji repeatedly'): 
    print(event)
```

# then the tcp dump shows:
```
...data: "Hello \xf0\x9f\x98"
...data: "\x8a world\n\n"
```

katie_engineer: ok so multi-byte split. but why auth rotation matters?

sasha_support: because our refresh hook fires, replace token, and the client does a 204 keepalive to the server, which interleaves with SSE stream and confuses parser when boundary occurs.

support_bot: Incident created INC-2026, assigned to eng-runtime

lee_sre: can we add a metric to count partial-utf8 events and failed-decodes? also add a retry for generator when heartbeat/204 interleaves.

katie_engineer: temporary workaround: pin python-sdk v0.9.0 or set env RW_SDK_STREAM_CHUNK_ALIGN=true (internal flag) until fix is out.

sasha_support: repro steps I used: 1) run local SSE server that deliberately splits utf-8 chars across chunks; 2) start client stream; 3) trigger auth refresh via short TTL key; 4) observe generator pause for ~30s then recovers.

jonathan_repro: notes: can't reproduce on go-client. seems python SSE parser uses str.decode before full event assembled.

katie_engineer: thanks. filing PR to change parser to operate on bytes and only decode full event. ETA EOD tomorrow for patch + unit test.

sasha_support: awesome, thx. will monitor INC-2026 and test nightly.

lee_sre: ops note: if customers see long stalls tell them to rotate to 0.9.0 and add keepalive header 'Prefer: avoid-refresh' as a stopgap.

sasha_support: marking this thread for customer followups. :thumbsup:
